requirements.quote:
A security-aware stub resolver MUST support the DNSSEC RR types, at
   least to the extent of not mishandling responses just because they
   contain DNSSEC RRs.
requirements.condition: The implementation is a security-aware stub resolver.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST support DNSSEC RR types at least to the extent of not mishandling responses solely because they contain DNSSEC RRs.
requirements.why_checkable: The response-processing path can be inspected and exercised with responses containing DNSSEC RRs to check whether their presence alone causes mishandling.
